tools.name: aigentic.ask
tools.description: Ask an AI a question and get its answer; the router picks the engine by difficulty unless one is pinned. The paid Claude API additionally requires the aigentic 'cost:api' right (hp_aigentic_api).

tools.name: aigentic.extract
tools.description: Extract the text contained in attached files (images, scans, PDFs) as plain text, reading text inside images too. Routes through the vision-aware router, so it carries the aigentic 'cost:api' right (hp_aigentic_api) — it may reach the paid Claude API.
